description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android activity called DeepLinkPostplayAliasActivity that handles URI-based deep linking for app-specific URLs. When a matching deep link is received, it creates a RatingInfo object with predefined rating data and forwards the intent to the PostPlaybackRatingActivity.

classes.name: DeepLinkPostplayAliasActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that handles deep linking for app://rating/postplay URLs and initiates a rating display with predefined data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; processes the intent's URI and triggers the rating activity if the URI matches specific criteria.
